message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "writeZipStreamToTempDir", "explanation": "The method receives an InputStream and delegates to processZipStream without any path traversal checks, allowing a malicious zip entry name to escape the temporary directory."}, {"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "processZipStream", "explanation": "The method constructs a File from the temporary directory and the tainted entry.getName() via new File(dir, entry.getName()), then opens a FileOutputStream on that File without validating that the resulting canonical path resides within the intended directory, enabling Zip Slip."}]}
